sources.entry: capcut-cli by René Zander - A zero-dependency Node CLI (and Claude Code plugin/skill) that lets the agent edit CapCut / JianYing video projects programmatically — inspect timelines, build drafts, add text/audio, word-level captions and Whisper transcription, templates, and cut long-form into shorts — JSON in, JSON out, no server. Deeply mature for a media tool: 205 tests across macOS/Windows/Linux

summary.one_liner: A zero-dependency Node CLI, library, and Claude Code skill that lets an LLM agent or person create and edit local CapCut / JianYing draft projects from JSON, with no server.
summary.what_it_does: Reads and writes the local CapCut/JianYing draft store directly, validating against a version-aware schema and writing back atomically with a .bak. Commands cover inspecting tracks, segments, texts and materials; building drafts from a JSON spec (compile, quickstart); adding video, audio and text (including Wikimedia URLs, license-checked); trims, speed, volume, transitions, masks, animations and easing; templates and portable text presets; and subtitles via caption, SRT/VTT import and export, and multi-language translate. It also provides a low-res ffmpeg preview (render), silence and scene detection, and cut for turning long-form footage into shorts. An opt-in experimental caption --cloud uploads audio to ByteDance for transcription; otherwise Whisper is used locally for captions.
use_cases: Generate an editable CapCut or JianYing draft from a script or spec
Add captions and subtitles to a video project
Convert a long recording into shorts using silence or scene detection
Let an AI agent inspect and edit a CapCut timeline safely
Batch-process drafts through a JSONL job queue
Create multi-language subtitle versions of a draft
stack: Anthropic API via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (optional, for translate)
notable: JSON in, JSON out design with no MCP server, HTTP daemon, or upload by default
Claude Code skill and plugin, installable via npx skills or the plugin marketplace
Works on both CapCut and JianYing enum namespaces via a flag
Experimental capability-free Wasm component exposing inspect, diff and lint-portable as read-only tools
Word-level captions and karaoke timings via whisper.cpp
caveats: Experimental caption --cloud uploads transcribed audio to ByteDance servers
Unofficial and not affiliated with CapCut or ByteDance; CapCut/JianYing version support is version-dependent (see docs/version-support.md)
Some features need optional external tools: Whisper, FFmpeg, ffprobe, or an Anthropic API key
